contexts.text: They are called wandering Spirits, and are compared to the fluids in the human body which rise up from the stomach...
The fluidity... of the speech is from this, that the celestial good in their ideas is such... The speech of the spiritual is also fluid, but not so soft and gentle.
Their reasonings are the fluids there which represent.
The introductions of these fluids (of the body) to uses, represent those inaugurations into gyres.
The fluidity which belongs to the form of Heaven is thus arrested.
They know how to make fluid fires.
These kinds of speech are like fluids...
In internal things the parts... are very fluid. (See Cohere.)
The less man has from himself... or the more fluid he is, the more perfect... In the inmost fibres there is nothing but what is fluid, because spiritual.
1.2. The more fluid it is in man... the more easily is he bent by the Lord...
Spirits act more fluidly without the attention of man...
Such a fibre could not operate at all without its fluid within, as a patient could not without an agent.
The gyre was not so fluid...
An influx... pearly, but still fluid.
